CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_sessions (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    session_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    channel TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            channel IN (
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'webchat',
                'manual',
                'api'
            )
        ),

    external_conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'active',
                'waiting_patient',
                'waiting_human',
                'completed',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fa'
        CHECK (
            language IN (
                'fa',
                'en',
                'ar',
                'unknown'
            )
        ),

    last_intent TEXT,
    pending_action TEXT,

    collected_entities JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    risk_flags JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,

    context_summary TEXT,

    last_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        clinic_id,
        channel,
        external_conversation_id
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_messages (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    session_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES conversation_sessions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    direction TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            direction IN (
                'inbound',
                'outbound',
                'internal'
            )
        ),

    sender_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            sender_type IN (
                'patient',
                'assistant',
                'human',
                'system'
            )
        ),

    message_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text'
        CHECK (
            message_type IN (
                'text',
                'audio',
                'image',
                'file',
                'event'
            )
        ),

    content_text TEXT,
    content_json JSONB,

    intent TEXT,

    intent_confidence NUMERIC(6, 5)
        CHECK (
            intent_confidence IS NULL
            OR (
                intent_confidence >= 0
                AND intent_confidence <= 1
            )
        ),

    extracted_entities JSONB,
    risk_flags JSONB,

    tool_action TEXT,
    tool_result JSONB,

    model_provider TEXT,
    model_name TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CHECK (
        content_text IS NOT NULL
        OR content_json IS NOT NULL
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_ai_runs (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    session_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES conversation_sessions(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    input_message_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES conversation_messages(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    model_provider TEXT,
    model_name TEXT,
    prompt_version TEXT,

    status TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'success',
                'error'
            )
        ),

    raw_output JSONB,
    parsed_output JSONB,
    error_message TEXT,

    latency_ms INTEGER
        CHECK (
            latency_ms IS NULL
            OR latency_ms >= 0
        ),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversation_sessions_active
    ON conversation_sessions(
        clinic_id,
        status,
        last_message_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversation_sessions_patient
    ON conversation_sessions(
        patient_id,
        last_message_at DESC
    )
    WHERE patient_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversation_messages_session
    ON conversation_messages(
        session_id,
        created_at DESC,
        id DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversation_messages_intent
    ON conversation_messages(
        intent,
        created_at DESC
    )
    WHERE intent IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conversation_ai_runs_session
    ON conversation_ai_runs(
        session_id,
        created_at DESC
    );

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار حافظه، پیام‌ها و اجرای مدل زبانی ایجاد شد.' AS message;

parameters.content:
## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow سه جدول برای جلسه مکالمه، پیام‌ها و ثبت اجرای مدل زبانی ایجاد می‌کند.

PostgreSQL مرجع اصلی حافظه مکالمه خواهد بود؛ بنابراین حافظه به اجرای موقت n8n وابسته نمی‌ماند.
